name: Validator Agent
description: Runs deterministic rule checks on an email intake record (sender, subject, document type, PDF attachment readability), then the real ennVault_org_backend validation gate: customer exclusion_config lookup + OCR-based invoice-format recognition, PII-masking every recognized word before the page ever reaches a vision LLM. Produces a pass/flag/block verdict, plus the masked page images and code-mapping the Extraction Agent needs.

skills.name: Validate Intake Record
skills.description: Checks an email intake record's sender, subject, document type and PDF attachment readability, then runs org_backend's real gate (customer config lookup + OCR format recognition + word-level PII masking), returning a pass/flag/block verdict, an is_valid flag, and (if valid) the masked page images plus the code-mapping file for the Extraction Agent.
examples: Validate this intake record for ERP processing: {...}
